title: The binding of souls: rekindled
description: A mod that adds souls, knives and everything in between
body:
The binding of souls adds many additions to the base game such as

1. The ability to obtain the souls of killed undead mobs
2. The ability to craft specific souls
3. The ability to banish mobs and players from existance (Go add lore to servers)
4. Many refrances to indie titles

Some things it adds.

New ores such as nether ruby and uranium
Ways to banish players (Basinshment is basicly making it so they can't do anything)
The ability to craft souls

This mod is still in beta, so there will be updates
